mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dic (name, sign, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{sign}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime});

insert into sys_dic_item (parent_id, label, value, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES
(#{item.parentId}, #{item.label}, #{item.value}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.createUser}, #{item.updateUser})
mapper.update: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dic WHERE sign = #{sign}
mapper.select:
select * from sys_dic
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND sign LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sign}, '%')
SELECT d.*, i.id AS itemId, i.parent_id, i.label, i.value FROM sys_dic d LEFT JOIN sys_dic_item i ON d.id = i.parent_id WHERE d.id = #{id}
select d.sign, i.id, i.label, i.value, i.update_time, i.update_user from sys_dic_item i left join sys_dic d on i.parent_id = d.id where d.sign = #{sign}
